text:
jia: Quick sync 1 support confusion: what does /configs/preview do vs apply? We need a spec.

marta: Console shows diff + route sim but no traceable id. Support wants an audit handle.

dyson: Preview must be read-only. No production SLO metric emission. It should write an audit event and emit sampled telemetry only.

laura: API idea: POST /v1/configs/preview -> { preview_id, diff, simulation, warnings } and return preview_id in response so console + logs can link.

jia: Sampling: default 1% for previews. If preview touches sensitive keys (auth/quotas/kms) escalate to 100% logging. Mark sensitive fields in schema.

marta: Introduce header X-Config-Mode: preview|preflight|apply. Preflight runs the simulator synchronously (5s timeout) and returns 409 + details when constraints/capacity checks fail.

dyson: Add capacity guard in preflight: compare expected QPS to pool capacity*headroom. If failing, return remediation steps (increase pool, enable fallback). No side-effects on routing metrics.

laura: Console UX: show "PREVIEW (not applied)" badge with preview_id and a "Promote to canary" action that preserves cohort and stores immutable snapshot.

jia: Action items: laura -> draft API + responses; dyson -> audit + sampled telemetry + sensitive escalation + capacity guard; marta -> RFC + dashboard mock.

ops-bot: Reminder: next config deploy window Tue 02:00 UTC. Preflights must finish before window to be included.
